verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a voice-agent platform, for example batch calls or bulk edits to agents and numbers. The evidence pack documents no such capability. The CLI, SDKs and MCP server manage resources individually. Per-agent automatic data retention, AI QA sampling of calls and uploading up to 25 voice-clone audio files are adjacent features, not bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
